decisions.reason: Sending KDP listing material in a doc file for manual entry does not change the required back matter or author biography content.
The manual transfer method for KDP listing material does not resolve or change the paperback cover design requirements.
The KDP listing-material workflow does not change the paperback format or 6 x 9 inch trim size.
The source changes how listing material will be supplied and entered, not the copyright-page publication attribution.
The KDP manual-entry workflow has no necessary effect on Chapter 18 heading typography.
Supplying listing material in a doc file does not change chapter-image coverage, placement, or presentation.
The source concerns KDP listing material and client data entry, not the authoritative manuscript file or its required textual content.
The listing-material handoff method does not affect chapter-image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
The KDP listing-material workflow does not alter the manuscript copyediting or approved passage requirements.
The source does not change the requirement to exclude the unintended newline marker from the book title.
